name: project
cmd: work=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/track-m-flags-project-XXXXXX") && tar -xzf archives/star-ab/receipts.tar.gz -C "$work" && for side in before after; do echo "SIDE=$side"; bun research/track-m/project-lane-b-capture.ts "$work/$side/star/capture.json.gz"; done

name: check
cmd: bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun run check && printf '%s\n' 'test(research): record checked flags-first p1 improvement' 'test(research): preserve flags-first trace custody' | while IFS= read -r message; do printf '%s\n' "$message" | bunx commitlint --default-config; done
